reuse.why: Calls the existing getScheduledAmount, which already decides the missing/number/range cases with the furthest-from-zero rule.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API shape of schedules is built.

scope.why: Two-line change: the type field and its value in the mapper.

maintainability.why: The API field follows the shared rule automatically whenever it changes.
